Off-peak a useful reminder for busy families
With that in mind
Travelers: Read Companion Animal Travel Desk guidance before you arrive.

Travelers should prepare one secure crate, keep documents ready, and use calm handling at check-in. Staff will review animal welfare, cabin fit, and any needed service notes before travel is approved. A clear plan helps avoid delays and reduces stress for the pet and the escorting traveler.

<<FACT F067>> Place the crate so the animal can stand, turn, and rest without pressure on the sides. Keep the bedding dry and remove loose items that could shift during loading. If you travel with a cat, bring the usual feeding and comfort items only if they are permitted by the desk. <<FACT F073>> Follow staff direction if the animal needs an early review or additional screening.

For reptile travel, the crate and animal must be presented exactly as instructed, with the container closed and labeled as required. <<FACT F066>> Report any change in condition before boarding, and keep communication direct and respectful so the desk can update the record without delay.

For help with forms, checks, and day-of travel guidance, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
